title: Terraform Infrastructure as Code
description: Manage cloud infrastructure with Terraform — init, plan, apply, state, modules, and best practices.

entries.label: Initialize
entries.description: Download providers and modules, initialize backend — run first in any Terraform directory

entries.label: Preview Changes
entries.description: Show what Terraform will create/modify/destroy without applying changes

entries.label: Apply Changes
entries.description: Apply a saved plan to provision or update infrastructure

entries.label: Destroy All
entries.description: Tear down all resources managed by this Terraform configuration

entries.label: Format Files
entries.description: Auto-format all .tf files to canonical style

entries.label: Validate Config
entries.description: Check configuration syntax and internal consistency (no API calls)

entries.label: Show State
entries.description: Display the current state or a saved plan in human-readable format

entries.label: Import Existing Resource
entries.description: Bring an existing resource under Terraform management

entries.label: List Resources in State
entries.description: List all resources currently tracked in the Terraform state

entries.label: Target Specific Resource
entries.description: Apply changes to only one specific resource (use sparingly)
